== Description ==

Players at tables in a game café, with costumed fans (scout troopers, a Jawa, a TIE pilot and an Imperial officer) behind them. Shared with the Players Committee's reminder for [[SWCCGinPublic|Play Star Wars CCG in Public Week]]; the post does not say where or when it was taken. Not yet identified.
